plugins.name: borg
plugins.label: Borg Backup
plugins.description: Run BorgBackup operations — create, prune, check, list, info, or compact — against local or remote repositories. Supports SSH remotes, passphrase authentication, deduplication, and compression.

plugins.name: docker
plugins.label: Docker
plugins.description: Run common Docker operations from an Orchelium workflow node — start, stop, restart, exec, run, pull, rm, logs, ps, inspect, and prune.

plugins.name: lxc-pct
plugins.label: LXC Container (PCT)
plugins.description: Manage Proxmox LXC containers using the pct command. Supports start, stop, restart, exec, status, and snapshot operations.

plugins.name: mount
plugins.label: Mount / Unmount
plugins.description: Mount or unmount filesystems on the agent — NFS, CIFS/SMB, block devices, LUKS encrypted volumes, loop files, bind mounts, and tmpfs.

plugins.name: mysql
plugins.label: MySQL / MariaDB
plugins.description: Backup, restore and manage MySQL / MariaDB databases. Uses mysqldump for exports and mysql / mysqlcheck for other operations.

plugins.name: opnsense
plugins.label: OPNsense Firewall
plugins.description: Query and manage OPNsense firewall configurations, backups, and diagnostics. Access backups, firmware status, firewall rules/aliases/NAT, and system diagnostics via the OPNsense REST API.

plugins.name: paperless-ngx
plugins.label: Paperless-ngx Backup
plugins.description: Backup and export Paperless-ngx document library via Docker. Manage maintenance mode and perform timestamped, compressed exports.

plugins.name: postgresql
plugins.label: PostgreSQL
plugins.description: Backup, restore and manage PostgreSQL databases. Uses pg_dump / pg_dumpall for exports and pg_restore / psql for imports.

plugins.name: proxmox-backup
plugins.label: Proxmox VM Backup
plugins.description: Run vzdump on a Proxmox host to back up one or more VMs or LXC containers. Supports all vzdump modes and storage targets.

plugins.name: rclone
plugins.label: Rclone
plugins.description: Sync, copy, move, or check files between any rclone-supported storage backend — local disk, S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, SFTP, WebDAV, B2, Azure, and many more.

plugins.name: restic
plugins.label: Restic Backup
plugins.description: Run a Restic backup, forget, or check operation against any supported repository — local, SFTP, REST server, S3, B2, Azure, GCS, and more.

plugins.name: rsync
plugins.label: Rsync
plugins.description: Synchronise or verify files between directories or hosts using rsync. Supports local-to-local, local-to-remote (SSH), and remote-to-local transfers.

plugins.name: s3
plugins.label: S3 Object Storage
plugins.description: Interact with Amazon S3 or any S3-compatible object store (MinIO, Wasabi, Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2, etc.) using the AWS CLI.

plugins.name: sqlite
plugins.label: SQLite
plugins.description: Backup, restore and manage SQLite database files. Uses the sqlite3 CLI — no server or authentication required. Supports online hot-backup, SQL dump/restore, and queries.

plugins.name: systemd
plugins.label: Systemd Service
plugins.description: Manage systemd services on the agent host — start, stop, restart, reload, enable, disable, or query service status using systemctl.

plugins.name: tar
plugins.label: Tar Archive
plugins.description: Create, extract, or list tar archives with optional gzip, bzip2, xz, or zstd compression. No dependencies beyond the standard tar command.

plugins.name: truenas
plugins.label: TrueNAS
plugins.description: Manage TrueNAS CORE and SCALE via the REST API v2.0. Supports ZFS snapshots, replication tasks, and cloud sync tasks.

plugins.name: zfs-send-receive
plugins.label: ZFS Send / Receive
plugins.description: Replicate ZFS datasets via zfs send | zfs receive. Supports full and incremental replication, recursive dataset trees, remote targets via SSH, and resume tokens.

plugins.name: zfs-snapshot
plugins.label: ZFS Snapshot
plugins.description: Create, destroy, list, rollback, or clone ZFS snapshots. Supports recursive operations, incremental sends, and remote replication via SSH.

plugins.name: wake-on-lan
plugins.label: Wake on LAN
plugins.description: Send a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to power on a sleeping machine on the local network. Uses Python 3 — no external tools required.

plugins.name: bitwarden
plugins.label: Bitwarden Export
plugins.description: Export a Bitwarden organisation vault to a password-protected ZIP file. Authenticates via API key and supports CSV, JSON, and encrypted JSON formats. Uses 7-Zip (AES-256) when available, with a zip fallback.

plugins.name: file-prune
plugins.label: File Prune
plugins.description: Delete files matching a wildcard pattern that are older than a specified number of days. Ideal for enforcing retention policies on backup archives, log files, database dumps, and other time-stamped files.
